run_validate_prototxt: run the script to validate a protobuf config file by loading and parsing it
run_validate_task_cfg: run the script with --is_task_cfg flag to validate a Task config protobuf file
run_validate_partial_cfg: run the script without flags to validate a partial config protobuf file
review_main_function: review the main function that loads conf.py and validates proto message config files
review_deprecated_check: review the deprecated config path check that skips loading files with DEPRECATED in the path
